title: CASSANDRA-21649 Delete SSTables in last-modified order (PR #5201, merge fixture)
notes: The merge golden fixture and quick-loop case, not a recall target in the research. PR #5201 backports CASSANDRA-21649 to 4.0, no GitHub review comments. K2 is stated in the ticket itself; K1 and K3 are findings the panel produced (.work/pr/5201/d1095cbd.../lenses/*.json, clusters A and C) and the research treated as correct, verified against the code by reading SSTable.java:109-124. They have no independent source, so source points at the PR. All three are marked soft (hard=false) because no post-merge bug ticket exists. K3's location is 'ticket', so files is empty. Minor findings D (comment wording) and E (CHANGES.txt) are not known issues. Caleb Rackliffe's JIRA comment of 2026-09-11 mentions a trunk-PR comment that was not located. Training contamination: low (September 2026) but recheck per model.
